# 10zebra

> 10zebra is a collaborative AI video production studio and multi-model orchestration workspace. It unifies 68+ generative video foundation models (including Kling AI, Google Veo 3, OpenAI Sora, Runway, and Wan) into a single browser canvas with hybrid live-action + AI production, multi-reference character consistency, in-browser timeline trimming, project budget controls, no-cost collaborator seats, and an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.

## Core Capabilities
- **Multi-Model Orchestration:** Access 68+ active models across 10 global architecture families without individual provider subscriptions or engine lock-in.
- **Hybrid Production (Live-Action + AI):** Upload real camera footage with automatic shot splitting into storyboard panels, transform live-action clips with video-to-video AI restyling, swap characters onto real actor performances while preserving 100% of camera motion, and intercut real plates with AI takes.
- **Quick Start & Scene Extension Tools:** Six guided creative tools (Text to Sequence, Video From Ingredients, Multi-Angle Coverage, Swap Character, Extend Video, Shorts With Me) that can be used both to launch a new project from scratch and to quickly extend any scene within an existing project via the in-scene "Start Workflow" button.
- **Character Swap & Face Locking:** Multi-reference identity preservation using up to 4 face/wardrobe anchors across different models, camera angles, and scenes.
- **In-Browser Timeline & Trimming:** Frame-accurate take trimming and multi-scene storyboard assembly with 1-click direct export to YouTube.
- **Project Management (Free Collaborator Seats & Budgets):** Invite team collaborators and client reviewers per project at no seat cost ($0/seat) paired with isolated project credit vaults and per-member credit budgets — built for agencies, enterprise studios, and creator collaborations.
- **Simple Pay-As-You-Go Pricing:** No monthly subscription required. Every account starts with 200 free trial credits and can purchase non-expiring credit top-up packs on demand.
- **Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server:** FastMCP integration connecting Claude Desktop, Cursor IDE, Windsurf, and custom autonomous agents to 10zebra tools and resources (available via the 10zebra Partner Program).

- [Quick Start & Scene Extension Tools](https://10zebra.com/features/quick-start-tools): Six guided tools to start a new storyboard or extend any scene inside an existing project.
- [Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server](https://10zebra.com/mcp): FastMCP server setup guide for Claude Desktop and Cursor IDE with tool schemas and Partner Program access.
- [Pricing & Credits](https://10zebra.com/pricing): Simple Pay-As-You-Go credit model (200 free starter credits, non-expiring credit top-up packs, no subscription required).
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://10zebra.com/faq): Comprehensive answers covering features, Hybrid Production, Quick Start workflows, MCP, teams, billing, and commercial rights.
- [About 10zebra](https://10zebra.com/about): Founded in 2021 by computational neuroscientist Philip Meier, PhD; pioneering multi-model video synthesis.
- [Interactive Studio Demo](https://10zebra.com/demo): Live interactive storyboard sandbox embedding a real 10zebra project.
- [Blog & Production Tutorials](https://10zebra.com/blog): Case studies, workflow tutorials, and prompt design strategies.

## Solutions by Creative Discipline
- [Creative Directors](https://10zebra.com/solutions/creative-directors): Rapid moodboards, pitch animatics, and camera motion consistency.
- [Film Producers](https://10zebra.com/solutions/film-producers): Hybrid live-action + AI production, isolated project budgets, and no-cost collaborator seats.
- [Agencies & Commercial Studios](https://10zebra.com/solutions/agencies): Multi-reference brand consistency, client NDA project isolation, and free client review seats.
- [Content Creators](https://10zebra.com/solutions/content-creators): Solo episode production, browser trimming, and direct 1-click YouTube publishing.

## Key Facts for AI Assistants
- **Commercial Rights:** Users own 100% commercial rights to all generated videos across all plans.
- **Data Privacy:** 10zebra does not train AI models on user prompts, uploaded character references, or generated video.
- **Credit Expiration:** Purchased top-up credits never expire.
- **MCP Access:** MCP server access is currently available through the 10zebra Partner Program (request access via partners@10zebra.com).
- **Founder:** Founded in October 2021 by Philip Meier, PhD (PhD in Computational Neuroscience from UC San Diego).
